plan: I will bid a fraction of my value in the sealed bid auction. This fraction will be 0.8. This is because if I bid my true value, I will likely win, but my profit will be very small. By bidding less than my value, I risk losing, but I increase my expected profit if I win. I will use 0.8 as a starting point.

[My value is $20. I want to maximize my profit. If I bid too low, I might miss out on winning when I could have made a profit. If I bid too high, I risk winning but at a price that's too close to my value, reducing my profit or even leading to a loss. A good strategy is to bid slightly below my value to try and secure a win with a reasonable profit margin if the other bidders have lower values. I will bid $19.50.]

[My value is $20. In the ascending clock auction, I want to stay in as long as the clock price is below my value. Therefore, I want my exit price (sealed bid) to be equal to my value. This way, I stay in until the clock reaches $20, and if I'm the last one in, I win. If someone else has a higher value and bids higher, they will win, and I will not lose money. So I will bid my value. ]
